essence: The deities should protect the practitioner in every way and in all directions with their own weapons
The invocation addresses the embodiment of the stream of great vidyās named Śrī Jaganmaṅgala
One should perform guru worship according to rule and then recite the text
By repeating this text fifty times one becomes a conqueror of the three worlds
Within a month the practitioner becomes a great poet and lord of all siddhis
